items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Max-Thinking reasoning model
items.summary: Qwen3-Max-Thinking is Alibaba's flagship reasoning model with adaptive tool use (search, memory, code) and test-time scaling, available in Qwen Chat and the Alibaba Cloud API. Alibaba claims performance comparable to GPT-5.2-Thinking and Gemini 3 Pro across 19 benchmarks.
